versions.changes: This update primarily focuses on enhancing the frontend template for Fingo. It includes general styling adjustments within `template.css` and minor structural modifications to `template.html`. A significant fix has been applied to `template.js` to resolve an issue with a dropdown component, improving its functionality.

This sync includes several refinements to the Fingo project's template. CSS updates improve font rendering by correcting a property value and introduce styling for a new loading state. The HTML template now enhances accessibility by adding an `aria-label` to the profile button. Lastly, JavaScript logic has been refined to correctly handle base paths and home links, improving navigation and resource loading across different pages.
